text: The back wall, floor to ceiling, and a ladder on a rail to reach the top.
Every vessel made in Caelora is up there somewhere, in nine sizes.
A village shop keeps two. This one keeps a wall.
A brass sign, old and well kept. HALLOWAY AND DAUGHTERS, 1041.
Under it a smaller one: AND STILL DAUGHTERS.
Somebody polishes both of them and does not polish anything else.
Imported stock, priced in three currencies, with the origin on each card.
Blackglass. The Sunder Isles. Somewhere called Veth.
Averra is a great deal larger than the map on your wall at home.
Potions by the case. Not the bottle. The case.
A card explains the discount and then explains, at length, why there is not
a bigger one, in the tone of a woman who has had this argument daily.
Cures, by ailment, in alphabetical order, with a chart above them
showing which Kin gives you which.
Somebody has scratched out an entry and written GO TO THE CLINIC, IDIOT.
Expedition kit. Rope, oilskin, a lamp that works wet, and a boxed set
labelled FOR THE NORTHERN ROAD, which nobody has bought this month
because the northern road is shut.
A locked case of the good vessels, and a price on each that makes
the quarry wage in Stonewake look like a rumour.
The card says HANDMADE IN CROWNSPIRE. TWO YEARS' WAIT.
Bulk feed, in sacks, by type, with a scoop chained to every bin.
There is a queue for this and no queue for anything else in the shop.
A city of a hundred and sixty thousand keeps a great many Kin fed.
Seconds and returns, in a bin, half price, sold as seen.
Half of it is Foundation surplus with the stencil sanded off.
It is perfectly good. It is also perfectly obvious where it came from.
